knowledge_assets.name: Alternate supplier approved at only some plants
knowledge_assets.situation: A supplier will miss a shipment of a material used at several plants, and the qualified alternate supplier is approved by the supplier portal at only some of those plants.
knowledge_assets.steps: [{"order": 1, "task": "SDR-1.2", "tool": "trace_supply_exposure", "do": "Trace the material to every finished good and the plant that makes each one."}, {"order": 2, "task": "SDR-2.1", "tool": "get_supplier_status", "do": "Read the alternate's approved_sites for the material in the supplier portal; check it is not on hold."}, {"order": 3, "task": "SDR-2.2", "tool": "create_purchase_requisition", "do": "Raise a requisition with the alternate for the late quantity, ship-to each approved plant only."}, {"order": 4, "task": "SDR-2.2", "tool": "create_escalation_case", "do": "Open a case for QUALITY_ASSURANCE to qualify the alternate at each plant it is not approved for."}, {"order": 5, "task": "SDR-2.4", "tool": "run_sql", "do": "Check DC stock vs safety stock for packs made at the uncovered plants (latest DC_INV snapshot)."}, {"order": 6, "task": "SDR-3.1", "tool": "create_allocation", "do": "Only if such a pack is below safety stock: allocate it per BR-ALLOC-01/02 (approval per BR-APPR-01) and notify account teams."}]
knowledge_assets.correction: Requisition only for the approved sites; qualification for the other sites goes to Quality; no allocation unless a pack made at an uncovered plant is below safety stock.
